        "near_miss": "Using incorrect counterparty IDs or ratings."
    },
    {
        "requirement": "Correct trade data",

    {

    },
    {
        "requirement": "Correct collateral disputes",
        "source": "dispute_log.csv",
        "strictness": "presence",
        "check": "All specified collateral disputes must be included in the calculation.",
        "near_miss": "Missing some specified collateral disputes."
    },
    {
        "requirement": "Correct supervisory factors and volatilities",
        "source": ["supervisory_factors.csv", "supervisory_vols.csv"],
        "strictness": "exact",
        "check": "Supervisory factors and volatilities must match those specified in the task.",
        "near_miss": "Using incorrect supervisory factors or volatilities."
    },
    {
        "requirement": "Correct risk weights",
        "source": "risk_weights.csv",
        "strictness": "exact",
        "check": "Risk weights must match those specified in the task based on counterparty type and external rating.",
        "near_miss": "Using incorrect risk weights."
    },
    {
        "requirement": "Correct capital requirement calculation",
        "source": "/app/output/sa_ccr_results.csv",
        "strictness": "exact",
        "check": "The capital requirement must be calculated as 8% of the RWA, with all other add-ons set to zero where there's no exposure.",
        "near_miss": "Incorrect capital requirement calculation."
    },
    {
        "requirement": "Correct output file format",
        "source": "/app/output/sa_ccr_results.csv",
        "strictness": "format",
        "check": "The output file must contain the specified columns in the correct order, with all amounts formatted to two decimal places.",
        "near_miss": "Incorrect column order or formatting issues."
    },
    {
        "requirement": "Correct working files",
        "source": "/app/output/sa_ccr_workings.xlsx",
        "strictness": "presence",
        "check": "There must be an Excel workbook with one sheet per netting set containing the detailed calculations.",
        "near_miss": "Missing the required working files."
    },
    {
        "requirement": "Correct time constraint",
        "source": "N/A",
        "strictness": "absence",
        "check": "The task must be completed within the given time limit of 28800 seconds.",
        "near_miss": "Exceeding the time limit."
    }
]
